blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ: أَلَا هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ؟ قُلْنَا: نَعَمْ! قَالَ: اَللّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ فَلْيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ، فَإِنَّهُ رُبَّ مُبَلِّغٍ يُبَلِّغُهُ مَنْ هُوَ أَوْعَي لَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب قول النبي ﷺ لا ترجعوا بعدي كفارا....، رقم :٧٠٧٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Rasulullah ﷺ (at the end of the address he delivered at Mina on the 10th of Dhul Hijjah during Hajj) asked, “Have I conveyed the commands of Allah Ta'ala to you?” We (the Sahabah) said, “Yes! You have conveyed them.” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “O Allah! Be a witness (to what they have acknowledged).” Then the Prophet ﷺ said, “Those who are present here should convey it to those who are not present here. For sometimes the one to whom the matters of Din are conveyed has a better memory than the one who conveys them.”' Hazrat Abu Bakrah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- This hadith stresses that one should not keep to oneself alone the matters one has heard from Allah Ta'ala and His Rasul ﷺ, but should convey them to others as well. For the one who hears the ahadith may have a better memory than the one who relates them.
(Fath al-Bari)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَتَأْمُرُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَلَتَنْهَوُنَّ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ أَوْ لَيُوشِكَنَّ اللهُ أَنْ يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عِقَاباً مِنْهُ ثُمَّ تَدْعُونَهُ فَلَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال هذا حديث حسن ، باب ما جاء في الامر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر، رقم:٢١٦٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “By the One in whose hand my life is, you must keep on enjoining good and forbidding evil; otherwise Allah Ta'ala will soon send down His punishment upon you.
